title: 경찰착용기록장치 운영 등에 관한 규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:34766:20240730:00001:part:1/1

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 34766, Jul. 30, 2024>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on July 31, 2024.

Article 2 (Special Cases Concerning Police Body-Worn Recording Devices)
(1) Where a police officer registers with the police agency or coast guard agency to which the officer belongs a recording device purchased individually by the officer that can be worn or carried on the body to record video and audio of the performance of duties at close range, or a mechanical device with similar functions, the device shall be deemed a police body-worn recording device until July 31, 2028.
(2) Matters necessary for the registration procedures under paragraph (1) and management of registered police body-worn recording devices shall be determined by the Commissioner General of the Korean National Police Agency or the Commissioner General of the Korea Coast Guard.
